All 45 endpoints, with the error statuses each can answer. A token is the access JWT, as a Bearer header or an `httpOnly` cookie. A refusal is `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`; a bad token is 401 (4401 on the socket), a trader on an admin route 403. "No key" means no idempotency key and no stated promise about a repeat. A GET marked "can write" does so once: a first balance read mints the signup grant (ADR 0009), a first snapshot opens the market's book.
